clips.send: Pingxingguan. Today: Lingqiu County, Shanxi. The Eighth Route Army ambushed a Japanese column in a narrow valley — the first big Chinese victory of the war.
clips.text: Pingxingguan. Today: Lingqiu County, Shanxi. The Eighth Route Army ambushed a Japanese column in a narrow valley — the first big Chinese victory of the war.

clips.send: Longyangxia. A dam on the upper Yellow River next to one of the biggest solar parks in the world — millions of panels on the Qinghai plateau.
clips.text: Longyangxia. A dam on the upper Yellow River next to one of the biggest solar parks in the world — millions of panels on the Qinghai plateau.

clips.send: Changning County. A county in Baoshan, western Yunnan. Its museum keeps a 1954 certificate for a deputy elected to the Yunnan Provincial People’s Congress.
clips.text: Changning County. A county in Baoshan, western Yunnan. Its museum keeps a 1954 certificate for a deputy elected to the Yunnan Provincial People’s Congress.

clips.send: Liujiagang. Today: Liuhe, Taicang, Jiangsu. Zheng He’s great fleet of over 200 ships and 27,000 men gathered here before sailing.
clips.text: Liujiagang. Today: Liuhe, Taicang, Jiangsu. Zheng He’s great fleet of over 200 ships and 27,000 men gathered here before sailing.

clips.send: Yarlung Zangbo River. Its valley is warm enough for highland barley. Downstream it cuts the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon, the deepest canyon on Earth.
clips.text: Yarlung Zangbo River. Its valley is warm enough for highland barley. Downstream it cuts the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon, the deepest canyon on Earth.

clips.send: Longbiao. Today: Hongjiang, Hunan. A remote town in the hills of western Hunan. When Li Bai heard his friend Wang Changling was sent here, he “sent his worried heart to the moon”.
clips.text: Longbiao. Today: Hongjiang, Hunan. A remote town in the hills of western Hunan. When Li Bai heard his friend Wang Changling was sent here, he “sent his worried heart to the moon”.

clips.send: Capital Museum. Today: Xicheng, Beijing. The museum of Beijing’s own history, with models of the old city and treasures found in the capital.
clips.text: Capital Museum. Today: Xicheng, Beijing. The museum of Beijing’s own history, with models of the old city and treasures found in the capital.

clips.send: Tours (Poitiers). Charles Martel and the Franks defeated an Umayyad army from Spain here. After this, Muslim armies did not push further into France.
clips.text: Tours (Poitiers). Charles Martel and the Franks defeated an Umayyad army from Spain here. After this, Muslim armies did not push further into France.

clips.send: Seattle. A port city on Puget Sound, at the western end of James J. Hill’s Great Northern Railway (1893). Its Space Needle was built for the 1962 World’s Fair, and on clear days snowy Mount Rainier looms behind the city.
clips.text: Seattle. A port city on Puget Sound, at the western end of James J. Hill’s Great Northern Railway (1893). Its Space Needle was built for the 1962 World’s Fair, and on clear days snowy Mount Rainier looms behind the city.

clips.send: Shenyang. Shenyang is a big industrial city. Its aircraft works built New China’s first jet fighter in 1956, and the Japanese invasion began here on 18 September 1931.
clips.text: Shenyang. Shenyang is a big industrial city. Its aircraft works built New China’s first jet fighter in 1956, and the Japanese invasion began here on 18 September 1931.

clips.send: Sierra Madre. Two long ranges, the Sierra Madre Occidental (west) and Oriental (east), that frame Mexico’s high central plateau.
clips.text: Sierra Madre. Two long ranges, the Sierra Madre Occidental (west) and Oriental (east), that frame Mexico’s high central plateau.

clips.send: Lin’an. Today: Hangzhou, Zhejiang. After 1127 the Song court moved south to Lin’an. Its West Lake has inspired poets for more than a thousand years.
clips.text: Lin’an. Today: Hangzhou, Zhejiang. After 1127 the Song court moved south to Lin’an. Its West Lake has inspired poets for more than a thousand years.

clips.send: Saihanba. Today: Weichang County, Chengde, Hebei. Three generations of foresters turned sandy wasteland here into one of the largest planted forests in the world, which helps shield Beijing from sandstorms.
clips.text: Saihanba. Today: Weichang County, Chengde, Hebei. Three generations of foresters turned sandy wasteland here into one of the largest planted forests in the world, which helps shield Beijing from sandstorms.

clips.send: Deccan Plateau. A large plateau covering most of southern India, built of ancient lava flows. Its black soil is good for growing cotton.
clips.text: Deccan Plateau. A large plateau covering most of southern India, built of ancient lava flows. Its black soil is good for growing cotton.

clips.send: Acre. Today: Akko, Israel. The Crusaders’ main port and last big stronghold in the Holy Land. When it fell in 1291, the Crusades in the East were over.
clips.text: Acre. Today: Akko, Israel. The Crusaders’ main port and last big stronghold in the Holy Land. When it fell in 1291, the Crusades in the East were over.

clips.send: Golden Isles. St. Simons, Jekyll, Sea Island and Little St. Simons are nicknamed the “Golden Isles” — some say for the marsh grass that glows gold at sunset. The port city of Brunswick is their gateway on the mainland.
clips.text: Golden Isles. St. Simons, Jekyll, Sea Island and Little St. Simons are nicknamed the “Golden Isles” — some say for the marsh grass that glows gold at sunset. The port city of Brunswick is their gateway on the mainland.

clips.send: Blue Mountains. Steep, forested mountains in northeastern Oregon, one of the last big obstacles on the trail. Emigrants chopped a road through the trees and let their wagons down the slopes with ropes, racing the early snow.

clips.send: Xiaogang Village. Today: Fengyang County, Anhui. In 1978, 18 farming families secretly signed a contract with red fingerprints to farm their own plots. Harvests jumped, and the idea spread across China.

clips.send: Guozijian (Imperial Academy), Beijing. Today: Dongcheng, Beijing. Next to Beijing’s Confucius Temple, students of the Imperial Academy learned the Analects by heart for the exams. Today it is a museum.

clips.send: Wuhou Shrine. Today: Chengdu, Sichuan. Zhuge Liang’s title was “Marquis Wu”, so his memorial temple is called the Wuhou Shrine. It stands next to Liu Bei’s tomb in Chengdu.

clips.send: Pudong. “Pudong” means “east of the Huangpu River”. In 1990 it was mostly farmland; today the towers of Lujiazui stand here.

clips.send: Baidicheng. Today: Fengjie, Chongqing. Li Bai wrote: “At dawn I left Baidi among the coloured clouds; a thousand li to Jiangling in one day.”
clips.text: Baidicheng. Today: Fengjie, Chongqing. Li Bai wrote: “At dawn I left Baidi among the coloured clouds; a thousand li to Jiangling in one day.”

clips.send: Mount Zion Baptist Church. Today: part of the Albany Civil Rights Institute. In 1961–62 the Albany Movement held its packed mass meetings in this small church, where people sang freedom songs and Martin Luther King Jr. spoke. The old church is now part of the Albany Civil Rights Institute.

clips.send: Baltimore. To win trade with the West, Baltimore began building the Baltimore and Ohio in 1828, one of America’s first railroads; by 1857 it reached St. Louis. Its old roundhouse is now the B and O Railroad Museum, full of historic locomotives.

clips.send: Athens. Home of the University of Georgia, where classes began in 1801; the founders named the town after ancient Athens, a famous center of learning. Today it is also known for music — bands like R.E.M. got their start here.

clips.text: Jinan. Jinan has more than 70 famous springs; the water of Baotu Spring bubbles up all year round.

clips.text: Tuotuo River. A wide, braided stream on the high plateau. The Qinghai–Tibet Railway crosses it.

clips.send: Uruk. Today: Warka, Iraq. Around 3000 BCE perhaps 40,000 people lived inside its walls. Some of the oldest writing ever found comes from its temples.

clips.send: Okefenokee Swamp. North America’s largest blackwater swamp covers about 438,000 acres; its name is often said to mean “trembling earth,” because floating peat islands shake when you step on them. Alligators, cranes and black bears live here, and it feeds the Suwannee and St. Marys rivers.

clips.send: Yan’an. Today: Yan’an, Shaanxi. From Yan’an the Party led the War of Resistance. The Seventh National Congress was held here in 1945. Its pagoda on the hill is a symbol of the revolution.

clips.send: Delaware. Swedes, then the Dutch, then the English ruled it. On 7 December 1787 it became the first state to ratify the Constitution — every vote was yes — so it calls itself “The First State”; in the Civil War it was a slave state that stayed in the Union.

clips.send: Chimney Rock. This clay-and-sandstone spire rises about 300 feet above the plains of western Nebraska and could be seen for days before emigrants reached it. More travelers wrote about it in their diaries than about any other landmark on the trail.

clips.send: Anatolia (Asia Minor). Today: Asian part of Türkiye. A big peninsula between the Black Sea and the Mediterranean — a bridge between Asia and Europe crossed by armies and traders for thousands of years.
clips.text: Anatolia (Asia Minor). Today: Asian part of Türkiye. A big peninsula between the Black Sea and the Mediterranean — a bridge between Asia and Europe crossed by armies and traders for thousands of years.

clips.send: Chuzhou. Today: Chuzhou, Anhui. “环滁皆山也” — the city is ringed by hills. Ouyang Xiu, demoted here at about 40, called himself the Old Drunkard and shared his joy with the people.

clips.send: Jordan River. A short river that flows south into the Dead Sea, the lowest place on land (about 430 m below sea level). Several countries share its scarce water.

clips.send: Fort Hall. A fur-trading post on the Snake River, built in 1834. Nearby, Shoshone and Bannock people traded dried salmon with emigrants — most meetings on the trail were peaceful; today the area is part of the Fort Hall Reservation.

clips.send: Quitman County. A small county on the Chattahoochee River and the Alabama line, with only about 2,000 people; its county seat is Georgetown. Under the county unit system its few voters had as much say as tens of thousands in Atlanta.

clips.send: Niuzhuang. Today: Yingkou, Liaoning. Niuzhuang was named in the treaty, but the river there was too shallow, so the port was actually opened at Yingkou near the sea.
clips.text: Niuzhuang. Today: Yingkou, Liaoning. Niuzhuang was named in the treaty, but the river there was too shallow, so the port was actually opened at Yingkou near the sea.

clips.send: 16th Street Baptist Church. This Birmingham church was a meeting place for civil rights marchers. On a Sunday morning in September 1963, a bomb planted by Ku Klux Klan members killed four girls — Addie Mae Collins, Cynthia Wesley, Carole Robertson and Carol Denise McNair — and the nation’s shock helped push Congress to pass the Civil Rights Act.

clips.send: Middle colonies. Today: New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware. They were called the “breadbasket colonies” because their rich soil grew so much wheat; barrels of flour sailed out of busy ports like Philadelphia and New York. People of many nations and religions lived side by side here.

clips.send: Chaeronea. Philip II of Macedon and his 18-year-old son Alexander won here, ending the independence of the Greek city-states. A stone lion marks the battlefield.
clips.text: Chaeronea. Philip II of Macedon and his 18-year-old son Alexander won here, ending the independence of the Greek city-states. A stone lion marks the battlefield.

clips.send: Helan Mountains. Today: Between Ningxia and Inner Mongolia. They block cold winds and desert sand from the west, helping the Ningxia Plain to be a green oasis — “Jiangnan beyond the frontier”.

clips.send: Hanyang Iron Works. Today: Hanyang, Wuhan, Hubei. The first large modern iron and steel works in Asia, started by Zhang Zhidong in the “seek wealth” stage of the Self-Strengthening Movement.

clips.send: Great Rift Valley. A giant crack in the Earth’s crust running thousands of kilometres through East Africa. The continent is very slowly pulling apart here.

clips.send: Louisiana Purchase. Today: central United States, from the Mississippi to the Rockies. In 1803 the United States bought this huge land from Napoleon’s France for $15 million — about 3 cents an acre — and roughly doubled in size. Parts of 15 of today’s states were carved from it, though Native nations still lived on the land and had never sold it.

clips.send: Changle. Today: Fuzhou, Fujian. The fleet waited at Changle for the northeast winter wind to blow it south.
clips.text: Changle. Today: Fuzhou, Fujian. The fleet waited at Changle for the northeast winter wind to blow it south.

clips.send: Pingcheng. Today: Datong, Shanxi. The Northern Wei ruled the north from Pingcheng. In 494 Emperor Xiaowen moved the capital south to Luoyang to be closer to the Central Plains.

clips.send: Baotou. A steel city by the Yellow River. Nearby Bayan Obo has one of the world’s largest rare-earth mines.
clips.text: Baotou. A steel city by the Yellow River. Nearby Bayan Obo has one of the world’s largest rare-earth mines.

clips.send: Bethesda orphan house. The preacher George Whitefield founded this orphan house near Savannah in 1740 and raised money for it with his famous outdoor sermons. It is one of the oldest children’s homes in America that is still running.

clips.send: Jamestown. In May 1607, 104 English men and boys built James Fort here — the first permanent English settlement in America. In the “starving time” winter of 1609–10 most of the settlers died; archaeologists found the real fort’s remains in 1994.

clips.send: Cowpens. On 17 January 1781 Daniel Morgan set a clever trap in this open cattle pasture: his militia fired two shots and fell back, and the charging British ran straight into his steady regulars. Nearly the whole British force was killed or captured.

clips.send: Gordon County. A northwest Georgia county where New Echota, the Cherokee capital, once stood. Its county seat is Calhoun, and New Echota Historic Site lies just outside town.

clips.send: Yongdingmen. The southern start of Beijing’s 7.8 km Central Axis. The gate was pulled down in 1957 and rebuilt in 2004–2005 from old drawings and photos.

clips.send: Ogeechee River. A dark “blackwater” river that flows about 290 miles from the Piedmont to the sea just south of Savannah. The 1763 Treaty of Augusta took the land between it and the Savannah River from the Creek, and in 1864 Sherman’s army stormed Fort McAllister at its mouth.

clips.send: James H. Floyd State Park. A quiet state park in the Valley and Ridge region, with two fishing lakes and a view of long Taylor Ridge. A side trail links it to the long-distance Pinhoti Trail.

clips.send: Yudu. Today: Yudu, Jiangxi. Over 80,000 Red Army soldiers crossed the Yudu River here on pontoon bridges at night to begin the Long March.
clips.text: Yudu. Today: Yudu, Jiangxi. Over 80,000 Red Army soldiers crossed the Yudu River here on pontoon bridges at night to begin the Long March.

clips.send: Chattahoochee River. Georgia’s best-known river. It starts in the Blue Ridge Mountains, flows past Atlanta and gives the city most of its drinking water.

clips.send: Fort Wilkinson. Today: Near Milledgeville, Georgia. At this frontier fort on the Oconee River, Creek leaders signed the 1802 Treaty of Fort Wilkinson, giving up the land between the Oconee and Ocmulgee rivers. Nothing of the fort stands today — only a historical marker.

clips.send: A-Ma Temple. A temple to the sea goddess Mazu. Portuguese sailors heard the name “Ma-Gau” here — that is where the name “Macao” comes from.

clips.send: Treasure Boat Shipyard. Today: Nanjing, Jiangsu. Long dry docks beside the Yangtze in Nanjing, where the giant treasure ships were built. A full-size model ship stands there today.

clips.send: Muye. Today: Xinxiang, Henan. Many of the Shang soldiers turned against King Zhou; the Shang fell and the Western Zhou began.
clips.text: Muye. Today: Xinxiang, Henan. Many of the Shang soldiers turned against King Zhou; the Shang fell and the Western Zhou began.

clips.send: Stork Tower. Today: Yongji, Shanxi. A tower by the Yellow River where storks used to nest. From the top Wang Zhihuan saw “白日依山尽, 黄河入海流”; the old tower was lost in war and rebuilt in 2002.

clips.send: Huiyan Peak, Hengyang. Today: Hengyang, Hunan. The first of the 72 peaks of Mount Heng. Legend says wild geese flying south go no further — so in 衡阳雁去 the geese go home, but the soldiers cannot.

clips.send: 乔治·华盛顿·卡弗国家纪念地。约1864年，乔治·华盛顿·卡弗出生在密苏里州戴蒙德附近这里的一座农场，生来就是奴隶。1943年，这里成为第一个纪念非裔美国人的国家纪念地。你可以沿着林间小路散步，少年卡弗就是在这片树林里观察植物的。

clips.text: 伯罗奔尼撒半岛。希腊南部的大半岛，几乎是一座岛。斯巴达率领这里的城邦组成伯罗奔尼撒同盟，与雅典对抗。

clips.send: 埃德蒙·佩特斯桥。1965年3月7日，州警在塞尔玛的这座桥上殴打约翰·刘易斯和霍齐亚·威廉姆斯带领的和平游行者，争取选举权的他们遭受了“血腥星期日”。两周后，成千上万的人再次走过这座桥，向蒙哥马利进发；同年8月，《选举权法》获得通过。

clips.send: 达里恩。1736年，苏格兰高地人建立达里恩守卫边疆；1739年，他们联名请愿，反对把奴隶制引入佐治亚。南北战争后，图尼斯·坎贝尔在这里组织获得自由的黑人，并当选州参议员。

clips.send: 独立岩。这是一块巨大的花岗岩圆丘，移民们在上面刻下或写下自己的名字——至今还能找到5000多个。篷车队都想在7月4日前赶到这里，这样才能在下雪前翻过大山。

clips.send: 普罗维登斯峡谷。“佐治亚的小大峡谷”其实一点也不古老：19世纪不当的耕作让雨水冲走了土壤，才形成这些深达约150英尺的沟壑。峡谷壁上有粉、橙、红、紫等颜色的条纹。

clips.send: 埃托瓦土丘。今天：卡特斯维尔附近的埃托瓦印第安土丘历史遗址。这座占地约22公顷（54英亩）的密西西比时期城镇有六座土丘、一个广场和一条防御壕沟，很可能就是德索托1540年见到的伊塔巴。A号土丘高约19米（63英尺），是人们一筐一筐运土堆起来的，是佐治亚最高的土丘；这里还出土了一对彩绘大理石雕像。

clips.send: 弗吉尼亚。1607年建立的詹姆斯敦使弗吉尼亚成为第一个长期存在的英国殖民地；1619年召开的弗吉尼亚议会是英属美洲第一个民选议会。美国前五位总统中有四位来自弗吉尼亚，独立战争的最后一场大战也发生在这里的约克镇。

clips.send: 阿比林。1867年，一位商人在堪萨斯州这个小镇的堪萨斯太平洋铁路旁修建了牛圈，得克萨斯牛仔便沿着奇泽姆小道把大群牛赶到这里，装上火车运往东部。后来，这里还是艾森豪威尔总统的家乡。

clips.send: 科罗拉多河。它从落基山脉流向墨西哥，全长约2300千米。大约600万年来，河水带着泥沙和石块不断磨蚀岩石，切出了科罗拉多大峡谷。

clips.send: 奇克莫加。这是佐治亚境内规模最大的战役：南方邦联获胜，双方伤亡和失踪约34,600人。联邦将领乔治·托马斯坚守阵地，被称为“奇克莫加之石”。1890年，这片战场成为美国第一个国家军事公园。

clips.send: 南部殖民地。这里气候温暖、生长季长，种植园主靠烟草、水稻和靛蓝发了财。这些财富来自被奴役的非洲人的强迫劳动——到1770年，这里大约每10个人中就有4个是奴隶。

clips.send: 路易斯安那购地。今天：美国中部（密西西比河至落基山脉之间）。1803年，美国用1500万美元从拿破仑统治的法国买下这片广大的土地——每英亩约3美分，国土面积几乎翻了一番。今天15个州的全部或部分土地都来自这里，但当时这片土地上仍生活着许多印第安民族，他们从未出售过它。

clips.send: 曼扎纳。今天：加州曼扎纳国家历史遗址。1942年第9066号行政命令颁布后，一万多名日裔美国人——大多数是美国公民——被迫住进内华达山脚下这座尘土飞扬、围着铁丝网的营地。安塞尔·亚当斯在这里拍下了营中的日常生活，背后是高耸的威廉森山。如今遗址上重建了一座岗楼。

clips.send: 西弗吉尼亚。弗吉尼亚州脱离联邦时，西部山区各县不愿跟随——那里很少有人家奴役黑人。它们从弗吉尼亚分离出来，在1863年战争正酣时作为新的西弗吉尼亚州加入联邦。

clips.send: 卡尼堡。1848年在普拉特河边修建的军营，用来保护过往的旅人，位于小道上约320英里处。移民们可以在这里取信件、买补给、修篷车。

clips.send: 西北领地。今天：俄亥俄、印第安纳、伊利诺伊、密歇根、威斯康星和明尼苏达一部分。1787年的《西北条例》禁止在这里实行奴隶制，并承诺由它建立的新州与老州地位平等；后来这里建起了五个州。肖尼人、迈阿密人等民族奋力保卫自己的土地，但1812年战争后失去了英国盟友。

clips.send: 胡佛水坝。大萧条时期，数千名急需工作的工人在内华达州和亚利桑那州之间的科罗拉多河上，修起了这座高726英尺（约221米）的混凝土大坝；它在胡佛总统任内开工，1936年在罗斯福任内完工。大坝拦出了米德湖，为数百万人发电。

clips.send: 克里克（马斯科吉）族。今天：佐治亚州中西部和亚拉巴马州东部。18世纪80年代，强大的克里克族是佐治亚边疆的近邻，这也是佐治亚希望有一个强有力的全国政府的原因之一。此后，克里克人的土地被一项项条约割走：到1827年，佐治亚境内已没有克里克人的土地；1836年，大多数克里克人被强行迁往印第安领地。

clips.send: 萨姆特堡。查尔斯顿港周围的南军炮台向这座建在小岛上的联邦要塞连续炮击了34个小时，直到守军投降——南北战争就此爆发。令人惊讶的是，炮击中没有一个人死亡。今天游客可以乘船登上这座要塞。

clips.send: 阿拉莫。今天：得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥。1836年，约200名守军——包括戴维·克罗克特、吉姆·鲍伊和几名得克萨斯墨西哥裔人——在这座旧传教站教堂里坚守了13天，最后墨西哥军队攻了进来。“记住阿拉莫！”从此成了得克萨斯人的战斗口号。

clips.send: 圣索菲亚大教堂。近一千年里，它的穹顶是世界上最大的。它先是教堂，1453年后改为清真寺，宣礼塔是奥斯曼人加建的。

clips.send: 山海关。今天：河北秦皇岛。北依燕山、南临渤海，所以叫山海关。老龙头处长城伸入大海。1644年清军由此入关。

clips.send: 倒影池。这个长长的水池从林肯纪念堂一直伸向华盛顿纪念碑，水面倒映着纪念碑的身影。1963年8月28日，约25万人聚集在池边参加“向华盛顿进军”，马丁·路德·金在这里发表了《我有一个梦想》的演讲。

clips.send: 华盛顿领地。今天：华盛顿州。1853年在美国西北角设立。1883年建成的北太平洋铁路穿过北部平原和落基山脉通到这里，移民随之大量涌入。1889年，它成为华盛顿州。

clips.send: 哈莱姆。纽约曼哈顿北部的一个街区，20世纪20年代哈莱姆文艺复兴时成为黑人文化的中心，诗人兰斯顿·休斯、作家佐拉·尼尔·赫斯顿，以及艾灵顿公爵、路易斯·阿姆斯特朗等爵士乐明星都活跃在这里。阿波罗剧院至今还举办着有名的“业余之夜”。

clips.text: 宁夏平原。宁夏平原引黄河水灌溉，在干旱地区种出水稻和果园，像江南一样，被称为“塞上江南”。

clips.send: 东非大裂谷。地壳上的一条巨大裂缝，在东非绵延数千千米。非洲大陆正在这里极其缓慢地裂开。
clips.text: 东非大裂谷。地壳上的一条巨大裂缝，在东非绵延数千千米。非洲大陆正在这里极其缓慢地裂开。

clips.send: 鹿野苑。佛陀在这里的鹿苑第一次说法。阿育王在这里立的狮子柱头，今天是印度的国徽图案。

clips.send: 塔卢拉河。这条山间河流切出了塔卢拉峡谷，峡谷长约2英里、深近1000英尺。1970年，走钢丝的卡尔·瓦伦达踩着钢索横越峡谷，途中还倒立了两次！

clips.send: 达洛尼加。1828—1829年，人们在这里的切罗基土地上发现了金子，成千上万的“二九淘金者”蜂拥而至——这是美国第一次大规模淘金热。镇广场上的旧法院大楼如今是黄金博物馆，佐治亚州议会大厦圆顶上的金箔也来自达洛尼加。

clips.send: 大沽炮台。今天：天津滨海新区。守卫海河入海口的炮台，是天津和北京的海上门户。《辛丑条约》规定拆毁大沽炮台。

clips.send: 小石潭。今天：湖南永州零陵。在永州城西的愚溪边，潭底是一整块石头，鱼儿“皆若空游无所依”。今天愚溪边有一处小石潭供人游览。

clips.send: 乌鲁木齐。乌鲁木齐是世界上离海洋最远的大城市，距海约2500千米。

clips.send: 普罗维登斯。罗杰·威廉斯因思想不容于马萨诸塞而被驱逐，1636年在从纳拉甘西特人那里得到的土地上建立了这座城。他用“天意”（上帝的眷顾）给它命名；今天它是罗得岛州的首府。

clips.send: 全国政协机关。中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会的办公地点，位于北京。全国政协委员每年3月与全国人大同时开会。

clips.send: 斯普林菲尔德。今天：马萨诸塞州斯普林菲尔德兵工厂国家历史遗址。1787年1月，丹尼尔·谢斯带领约1500名被债务和赋税压垮的愤怒农民，想夺取这里储存的武器；州民兵开炮把他们打散了。软弱的中央政府连一支军队都派不出来——这正是领导人们想制定新宪法的原因之一。

clips.send: 阿尔卑斯山。欧洲最高的山脉。公元前218年，迦太基统帅汉尼拔率领战象翻越这里进攻罗马。

clips.send: 大屿山。今天：香港。香港最大的岛屿，香港国际机场和港珠澳大桥香港口岸都在这里。
clips.text: 大屿山。今天：香港。香港最大的岛屿，香港国际机场和港珠澳大桥香港口岸都在这里。

clips.send: 罗马市。罗马市位于山谷与山脊区，埃托瓦河与乌斯塔诺拉河在这里汇合成库萨河。和古罗马一样，它建在七座山丘上——1834年它就因此得名。

clips.send: 阳朔。今天：广西桂林。漓江边的小城，四周是从稻田里拔地而起的喀斯特峰林。

clips.send: 马蹄弯。为了在阿尔图纳附近爬上陡峭的阿勒格尼山，铁路把轨道弯成一个巨大的U形。马蹄弯1854年通车，今天长长的货运列车仍吱吱作响地绕弯而过。二战时，德国曾派破坏分子来炸它，但他们还没动手就被抓住了。

clips.send: 奥本大道。种族隔离时期，亚特兰大的黑人被挡在白人商店门外，他们就在这里开办自己的银行、保险公司、报社和教堂，“甜蜜奥本”被称为“世界上最富有的黑人街道”。1929年，马丁·路德·金就出生在这条街上。

clips.send: 汉考克营。今天：佐治亚州奥古斯塔市内旧址。宾夕法尼亚的第28“拱心石”师在奥古斯塔城边的这座营地受训，这里还有陆军最早的机场之一。1918年致命的流感袭来，约3,000名士兵病倒，营地因此被隔离。

clips.send: 萨瑟机场。今天：阿梅里克斯吉米·卡特地区机场。第一次世界大战期间，近2,000名军队飞行员在阿梅里克斯东北的这座机场学会了飞行。1923年，年轻的查尔斯·林德伯格在这里买下了他的第一架飞机，并第一次单独驾机飞行——四年后，他独自飞越了大西洋。

clips.send: 亚特兰大大学。今天：克拉克亚特兰大大学（1988 年合并）。南北战争后，亚特兰大大学、克拉克学院、莫尔豪斯学院和斯佩尔曼学院在这里相继建起，让获得自由的黑人和他们的孩子能够上学。杜波依斯在这里任教，写下了《黑人的灵魂》。今天这几所学校组成了美国最大的黑人大学群。

clips.send: 安庆内军械所。今天：安徽安庆。洋务运动最早的军事工厂之一，这里的工匠造出了中国第一艘小火轮。
clips.text: 安庆内军械所。今天：安徽安庆。洋务运动最早的军事工厂之一，这里的工匠造出了中国第一艘小火轮。

clips.send: 美国最高法院大楼。最高法院的九位大法官在这座大理石建筑里审理案件。正门的柱子上方刻着“法律之下人人享有平等正义”。

clips.send: 桃花源。今天：湖南常德桃源县。文中的桃花源是陶渊明虚构的理想社会，“后遂无问津者”。湖南常德桃源县的桃花源是后人依照文章命名的景区，一千多年来不断修建亭台庙宇。

clips.send: 海口。海口面向琼州海峡，渡轮把火车和汽车从广东运过海。

clips.send: 非洲东海岸。郑和船队到达非洲东海岸的木骨都束、麻林，比欧洲船队绕过非洲早了几十年。

clips.send: 斯堪的纳维亚半岛。欧洲最大的半岛，挪威和瑞典在这里：大西洋一侧峡湾幽深，波罗的海一侧地势较缓。

clips.send: 大泽乡。今天：安徽宿州东南。九百名戍卒被大雨所阻，误期当斩，于是在这里揭竿而起，这是我国历史上第一次大规模农民起义。

clips.send: 西柏坡。今天：河北平山。党中央在这个小山村指挥了辽沈、淮海、平津三大战役。

clips.send: 哈拉帕。今天：巴基斯坦旁遮普省。考古学家最早发掘的印度河城市（20世纪20年代），所以这一文明也叫“哈拉帕文明”。城里有大粮仓和砖房。

clips.send: 密州。今天：山东诸城。苏轼在密州写下《江城子·密州出猎》（1075年），又在他修葺的超然台上，于1076年中秋写下怀念弟弟的《水调歌头》。

clips.send: 加利福尼亚。今天：美国。和我国北方一样，干旱的南加州也靠长达几百千米的渠道和引水工程从远方调水。

clips.send: 滕王阁。今天：江西南昌。江南三大名楼之一（另两座是黄鹤楼、岳阳楼）。唐代王勃的《滕王阁序》让它名扬天下。

clips.send: 辽上京。今天：内蒙古巴林左旗。契丹首领耶律阿保机建立辽，在草原上修建了上京。

clips.send: 戴维营。这是美国总统在马里兰州山林里的私人休养地。1978年9月，吉米·卡特把以色列和埃及的领导人请到这里谈了13天，最终达成《戴维营协议》，为两国实现和平铺平了道路。

clips.send: 南四湖。今天：山东西南部。微山湖、昭阳湖、独山湖、南阳湖四湖相连，紧靠京杭运河，南水北调东线从这里经过。

clips.send: 布尔河（马纳萨斯）。今天：弗吉尼亚州马纳萨斯国家战场公园。不少华盛顿市民带着野餐赶来观战，以为联邦军会很快获胜，结果却是邦联军赢了。托马斯·杰克逊将军坚守阵地，像一堵石墙，从此得名“石墙”杰克逊。今天可以在亨利山起伏的田野上漫步。

clips.send: 班夫国家公园。加拿大第一个国家公园，位于艾伯塔省的落基山脉，有梦莲湖等碧绿色的冰川湖。
clips.text: 班夫国家公园。加拿大第一个国家公园，位于艾伯塔省的落基山脉，有梦莲湖等碧绿色的冰川湖。

clips.send: 匹兹堡。煤、铁和三条河让匹兹堡成为美国的“钢铁之城”。1875年，安德鲁·卡内基在附近开办埃德加·汤姆森钢铁厂，采用贝塞麦炼钢法，来自欧洲的移民在炽热的炉前做工——这座工厂至今还在炼钢。1920年，这里的KDKA电台开始了最早的定时广播。
